## Beta — Own entity picker (search + dropdown)

The rule dialog now has its own entity picker instead of relying on Home Assistant's internal `ha-entity-picker`, which crashed while rendering in some setups (`Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'localize')`) and left the plain text box in place.

- Search by name or entity id (several words are matched in any order).
- Dropdown with icon, friendly name and entity id; keyboard support (↑ ↓ Enter, Esc) and mouse.
- Respects the card's include/exclude domain options.
- You can still type any entity id by hand.
- Depends only on `hass.states`, so it behaves the same on every Home Assistant version.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/andker87/Home-Assistant-ChronoTask/compare/v1.4.0-beta5...v1.4.0-beta6
